import * as db from 'zapatos/db';
import type { Row } from './generated/zapatos/queries';

export const users = db.sql<never, Row<'users'>[]>`SELECT u.id, settings, mood, scores FROM public.users u JOIN public.accounts a ON a.owner_id=u.id`;
const row: Row<'users'> = { id: 1, settings: { enabled: true }, mood: null, scores: [[1, null]] };
row.id.toFixed();
row.mood = 'happy';
// @ts-expect-error pg decodes an int4 as a number
row.id = 'one';
// @ts-expect-error the primary key cannot be null
row.id = null;
// @ts-expect-error the array column cannot be null
row.scores = null;
// @ts-expect-error the enum admits only its labels and null
row.mood = 'absent';
